entries.jp: ――翌日
entries.en: --The next day.

entries.jp: ほら　さくさく歩きなよ\nこの罪人共がっ
entries.en: Come on,\nwalk faster,\nyou criminals!

entries.jp: いたーっ！\n尻に何か刺さったぜよ！
entries.en:
Yeowch!
Somethin' just
stabbed me in
the backside!

entries.jp: おい　沖田！\n槍で突くんじゃねえ！
entries.en: Hey, Okita!\nQuit poking us\nwith that spear!

entries.jp: 馴れ馴れしく話し掛けるな\n立場がわかってるのか？
entries.en:
Don't talk to me
so familiarly. Do
you understand
your position?

entries.jp: こうしないと　他の武士に\n怪しまれちゃうでしょ？
entries.en:
If I don't do this,
the other
samurai will get
suspicious, right?

entries.jp: それはそうだが\nお前　ちょっと楽しんで\nないか
entries.en:
That's true,
but... aren't
you enjoying
this a little?

entries.jp: 楽しいに決まってるでしょ
entries.en: Of course I'm\nenjoying it.

entries.jp: 新選組の隊士として\n罪人を粛正するのは\n喜びの極みなんだから
entries.en:
As a Shinsengumi
trooper, there's
no greater joy
than purging
criminals.

entries.jp: ほら\nきりきり歩けってば！\nあはははは
entries.en: Come on,\nmarch! Snap to\nit! Ahahahaha!

entries.jp: さすがはソウちん\n迫真の演技ぜよ
entries.en:
That's So-chin
for ya! What
a convincin'
performance!

entries.jp: 演技か？\n本当に演技なのか？
entries.en: Performance?\nIs it really a\nperformance?

entries.jp: 晋作\n二条城に入るまでの\n辛抱です
entries.en:
Shinsaku, just
bear with it until
we're inside Nijo
Castle.

entries.jp: わかってる\nわかってるが\nくそっ
entries.en: I know. I know,\nbut... dammit!

entries.jp:
沖田に小突かれて
歩きながら龍馬は
行く先に見える
二条城を見上げた
entries.en:
Prodded along
by Okita, Ryoma
looked up at Nijo
Castle, visible
ahead of them.

entries.jp: それにしても\nすごい城じゃなあ
entries.en: Still, that's one\nheck of a castle!

entries.jp: 内部にも　仕掛けが\n色々施されているらしいよ
entries.en:
They say there
are all kinds of
contraptions
built inside, too.

entries.jp: 千利休っていう発明家に\n昔の人が城全体を改造\nさせたんだって
entries.en:
Apparently,
people long ago
had an inventor
named Sen no
Rikyu remodel
the whole castle.

entries.jp: あくまで噂だ\n本気にするな\nただ……
entries.en: It's only a rumor.\nDon't take it\nseriously. Still...

entries.jp: 二条城には巨大な\n音響装置（スピーカー）が\n組み込まれていると聞く
entries.en:
I hear Nijo
Castle has
huge speakers
built into it.

entries.jp: すべて発動させれば\n京中に天歌を流すことも\n可能だろう……
entries.en:
Set them all off,
and you could
probably play
Heaven's Song
over all of Kyoto...

entries.jp: ということは\n京中に天歌を流したのは\nやはり幕府か……
entries.en:
Which means it
was the
shogunate that
played Heaven's
Song all over
Kyoto after all...

entries.jp: どれだけのエレキが\n必要か想像もつきません
entries.en:
I can't even
imagine how
much electricity
that would take.

entries.jp: お　おい！\nアレを見ろ
entries.en: H-hey! Look\nat that!

entries.jp: 龍馬が二条城への\n門を指す
entries.en: Ryoma pointed\nat the gate to\nNijo Castle.

entries.jp: そこには門を警備していた\nであろう　侍達の倒れ臥す\n姿があった
entries.en:
There lay the
collapsed figures
of samurai who
must have been
guarding it.

entries.jp: これはどうしたぜよ？
entries.en: What happened\nhere?

entries.jp: 怖がる
entries.en: Get scared

entries.jp: 確かめる
entries.en: Check them

entries.jp: 助ける
entries.en: Help them

entries.jp: こいつらも眠り病に\nやられてるようじゃ\n恐ろしい力ぜよ
entries.en:
Looks like these
fellas got hit by
the sleeping
sickness too.
That's one
scary power.

entries.jp: ……まさか　二条城まで\n被害に遭うなんて
entries.en: ...I never thought\neven Nijo Castle\nwould be hit.

entries.jp: 将軍様のおわす城を\n守る侍が\n覚悟が足りん！
entries.en:
Samurai guarding
the castle where
the shogun
resides, and this
is their resolve!?
Disgraceful!

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさん\nそれは無茶ぜよ
entries.en: Hijizo-san, that's\naskin' too much!

entries.jp: 魂を抜かれたように\n眠ってるぜよ
entries.en:
They're sleepin'
like their souls
got pulled
right out.

entries.jp: お登勢さんや町の人達と\n同じです
entries.en: Just like\nOtose-san and\nthe townspeople.

entries.jp: どうも話が\nおかしくなって\nきやがった
entries.en: Something about\nthis is getting\ndamn weird.

entries.jp: おい\n大丈夫か？\nしっかりするぜよ
entries.en: Hey! You all\nright? Pull\nyourself together!

entries.jp: だめだ……町の連中と\n同じように反応が無い
entries.en: No good... no\nresponse, just like\nthe townsfolk.

entries.jp: いよいよ　おかしな事に\nなってきたな……
entries.en: This is getting\nstranger and\nstranger...

entries.jp: どう思う？
entries.en: What do\nyou think?

entries.jp: 城内の人たちも\n倒れとるんかな\n心配ぜよ
entries.en:
I wonder if the
folks inside the
castle are down
too. I'm worried.

entries.jp: そういうことじゃねえ
entries.en: That's not\nwhat I mean.

entries.jp: 謎の眠り病の原因が\n幾松が聞いた子供の声の\n天歌だとしてだ
entries.en:
Say the
mysterious
sleeping sickness
is caused by
Heaven's Song, in
that child's voice
Ikumatsu heard.

entries.jp: 目的はわからんが\n二条城の音響施設を\n使って京中に流した
entries.en:
No idea why,
but someone
used Nijo
Castle's sound
system to play it
all over Kyoto.

entries.jp: 幕府なら　それも容易だ\nそう思っていたが――
entries.en:
For the
shogunate,
that'd be easy.
That's what I
thought, but--

entries.jp: 二条城の門番まで\n昏睡状態に陥って\nやがる
entries.en:
Even Nijo Castle's
gatekeepers have
fallen into a
coma.

entries.jp: 幕府の仕業だとすれば\n辻褄が合いません
entries.en:
If it were the
shogunate's
doing, it
wouldn't add up.

entries.jp: とにかく城内へ\n急ぐぜよ！
entries.en: Anyway, let's\nhurry inside\nthe castle!

entries.jp: こうなった以上　罪人の\nふりをしている必要はねえ
entries.en:
Now that it's come
to this, there's no
need to keep
playing prisoners.

entries.jp: おい　縛っている縄を\n切ってくれ
entries.en: Hey, cut these\nropes off us.

entries.jp: なーんだ　もう終わりか\nもっとスカシ君を　槍で\n突いておけば良かったな
entries.en:
Aww, over
already? I
should've poked
Mr. Poser with my
spear a lot more.

entries.jp: いいから縄を切れ！
entries.en: Just cut the ropes!

entries.jp:
捕縛の縄を切り
身体の自由を取り戻した
龍馬達は　二条城へと
駆け込んだ
entries.en:
Cutting their
bonds and
freeing their
bodies, Ryoma
and the others
rushed into
Nijo Castle.

entries.jp: 城内に入ると\n異様な空気は\n更に強くなる
entries.en:
Once inside, the
eerie atmosphere
grew even
stronger.

entries.jp:
腰元　侍
茶坊主 老若男女
身分の差も無く
一様に人々は倒れ
眠っていた
entries.en:
Maids, samurai,
tea attendants,
young and old,
men and women...
whatever their
rank, all lay
collapsed, asleep.

entries.jp: 町の人々と一つだけ\n違うとしたら
entries.en: If there was one\ndifference from\nthe townspeople...

entries.jp:
その顔が
ひどく苦しげで
胸や頭を掻きむしった
ような様子が見て
取れることだ
entries.en:
...it was that their
faces were
twisted in agony,
as if they had
clawed at their
chests and heads.

entries.jp: これは酷い……\n極楽というより地獄でも\n見てきたという顔だ
entries.en:
This is terrible...
Those are the
faces of people
who've seen hell,
not paradise.

entries.jp: 表情こそ違うけど\nこれはどこかで見たことが\nあるような……
entries.en:
Their
expressions are
different, but I
feel like I've seen
this somewhere
before...

entries.jp: そうだ　彦根での鳳舞合奏\nあの時の民達の状態に\nよく似てる
entries.en:
Right. The
Phoenix Rising in
Hikone. It's very
similar to the
state the people
were in then.

entries.jp: あれはじわじわと\n意思と魂を奪っている\nような感じでしたが……
entries.en:
That one seemed
to drain their will
and souls little by
little, but...

entries.jp: こちらは一瞬にして\n奪われた\nという感じかな
entries.en:
This looks
more like they
were stolen in
an instant.

entries.jp: 天歌を聞いても　\nここまでにはならん
entries.en:
Even hearin'
Heaven's Song
never did this
much to folks.

entries.jp: せいぜい　やる気が\n無くなるくらいじゃと\nそう思っとったが……
entries.en:
I figured the
worst it did
was sap your
get-up-and-go,
but...

entries.jp: ……その程度ですむように\n井伊が調節していたんだよ\n生かさず殺さずね
entries.en:
...That's because
Ii kept it adjusted
to just that much.
Keeping them
alive, but only
barely.

entries.jp: どちらが良いという話じゃ\nないが　しかし　これは\n酷い有様ぜよ……
entries.en:
Ain't a question
of which is better,
but still... this is a
terrible sight...

entries.jp: な　なんじゃ\nこの音は
entries.en: Wh-what's\nthat sound?

entries.jp: 二条城のカラクリが\n動く音……？
entries.en:
The sound of
Nijo Castle's
contraptions
moving...?

entries.jp: おい　なんだか床が\nぐらぐらしてないか？
entries.en: Hey, isn't the\nfloor kind of\nwobbling?

entries.jp: これはヤバそうじゃ\n走るぜよ
entries.en: This looks bad!\nRun for it!

entries.jp: ちょっと待って\nこういう場合は\n正しい道以外は――
entries.en:
Wait a moment!
In cases like this,
anything but the
correct path is--

entries.jp: あっ
entries.en: Ah!

entries.jp: わぁ～～～～っ
entries.en: Waaaaaaaah!

entries.jp: ……バカ
entries.en: ...Idiot.

entries.jp: す　すまん……
entries.en: S-sorry...

entries.jp: ただの落とし穴で\n命拾いしたね……
entries.en: Lucky for us it\nwas just a pitfall...

entries.jp: ここはどこだろう？
entries.en: Where are\nwe, I wonder?

entries.jp: 普通の廊下のようだな\n歩いていれば　階段が\n見つかるだろう
entries.en:
Looks like an
ordinary
corridor. If we
keep walking,
we'll find stairs.

entries.jp: しょうがねぇ\n行くぜ
entries.en: Can't be helped.\nLet's go.

entries.jp: 五人は長い廊下を慎重に\n抜け　階段を上り\n天守を目指した
entries.en:
The five carefully
made their way
down the long
corridor, climbed
the stairs, and
headed for the
keep.

entries.jp: 本当に広い城だね\n見掛けから想像するより\nずっと複雑で広大だ
entries.en:
This castle really
is huge. Way
more complex and
vast than it looks
from outside.

entries.jp: 前に来たときは\nここまで広くなかった\n気がするんだが……
entries.en: I don't think it\nwas this big when\nI came before...

entries.jp: ちゃんと思い出せよ\nここに来たことがあるのは\nお前だけなんだ
entries.en:
Remember
properly.
You're the only
one who's ever
been here.

entries.jp: 一度だけだ\n少し待て……\n今　思い出す
entries.en: Only once. Wait\na moment... I'll\nremember.

entries.jp: それにしても\nおかしいですね
entries.en: Still, this\nis strange.

entries.jp: 広いのはともかく\n城内に誰も見当たらない
entries.en:
The size aside,
there's no one
to be seen in
the castle.

entries.jp: みんな眠っているんだろ
entries.en: They're all\nasleep, I bet.

entries.jp: だとしても　その眠って\nいる侍に一人くらい\n会ってもいいんじゃ？
entries.en:
Even so, shouldn't
we have come
across at least
one sleeping
samurai?

entries.jp: 座敷にでもいるんじゃ\nないか？
entries.en: Maybe they're\nall in one of\nthe rooms?

entries.jp: いないね
entries.en: Nobody here.

entries.jp: じゃ　こっちか？
entries.en: Then how\n'bout this way?

entries.jp:
そう言って龍馬が
襖に手を掛けたとき
不思議な声が
聞こえてきた
entries.en:
As Ryoma put
his hand on a
sliding door, a
strange voice
reached his ears.

entries.jp: ……しくしくしく
entries.en: ...*sob sob sob*

entries.jp: なんじゃ？\n今　何か聞こえ\nなかったか？
entries.en: What's that?\nDidn't you just\nhear somethin'?

entries.jp: おい\n誰もいないぞ
entries.en: Hey. There's\nnobody here.

entries.jp: し　しかし……
entries.en: B-but...

entries.jp: どこに……いるの？
entries.en: Where... are you?

entries.jp: ほら\n子供の声が\n聞こえるぜよ
entries.en: There! I can\nhear a child's\nvoice, I tell ya!

entries.jp: 私達には\n何も聞こえませんが……
entries.en: We don't hear\nanything...

entries.jp: 淋しいよ……\n悲しいよ……\n助けて……
entries.en: I'm lonely... I'm\nsad... Help me...

entries.jp: もしや\n奥の方に……
entries.en: Could it be...\nfarther in...?

entries.jp: 他の四人には\n聞こえない\n不思議な声
entries.en: A strange voice\nthe other four\ncouldn't hear.

entries.jp: その切なそうな響きに\n導かれて　龍馬は\n奥の座敷の襖を開けた
entries.en:
Drawn by its
sorrowful sound,
Ryoma opened
the sliding door
to the inner room.

entries.jp: な　なんじゃ\nこりゃあ
entries.en: Wh-what in the\nworld is this?

entries.jp: 龍馬が開けた先……\nその先には\n闇が広がっていた
entries.en:
Beyond the door
Ryoma opened...
lay a spreading
darkness.

entries.jp: ……坂本
entries.en: ...Sakamoto.

entries.jp: 異変に気づいた土方が\n真っ先に顔を上げる
entries.en:
Sensing
something wrong,
Hijikata was the
first to look up.

entries.jp: おい\n坂本はどこに行った？
entries.en: Hey. Where did\nSakamoto go?

entries.jp: 龍馬なら――\nあん？　あいつ\nどこへ行きやがった？
entries.en:
Ryoma? He's
right-- Huh?
Where the hell
did he go?

entries.jp: トサカくーーん
entries.en: Tosaka-kuuun!

entries.jp: 龍馬くーーん
entries.en: Ryoma-kuuun!

entries.jp: \fnt1うぁぁぁぁぁぁ\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Waaaaaaaah!\fnt0

entries.jp: 龍馬の体は\nそのまま闇に\n呑まれて消えた……
entries.en:
Ryoma's body
was swallowed
by the darkness
and vanished...

entries.jp: 龍馬が目を覚ましたのは\n豪奢な部屋だった
entries.en: When Ryoma\ncame to, he was\nin a lavish room.

entries.jp: 襖を開けたら\nどーんと闇が\n広がっとって――
entries.en:
I opened that
sliding door, and
whoosh!
Darkness spread
out everywhere...

entries.jp: 闇の向こう側から\n急に体を引っ張られて――
entries.en:
Then somethin'
yanked me in
from the other
side of the dark...

entries.jp: それから\nどうなったぜよ？
entries.en: And then what\nhappened?

entries.jp: おーい！\nシンディー！\nセンセー！
entries.en: Hellooo! Shindyyy!\nSenseiii!

entries.jp: わしゃあ　また\nはぐれてしもうたのか
entries.en: Don't tell me I got\nseparated again...

entries.jp: 自慢じゃないが\nわしは西も東もよく\nわからんからなぁ
entries.en: Not to brag,\nbut I can't tell\neast from west.

entries.jp:
しかし　ここは
どこなんじゃ？
随分といい部屋のように
みえるが
entries.en:
But where
am I? Looks
like a mighty
fine room...

entries.jp: 室内には数え切れないほど\n燭台が並び　煌々と室内を\n照らし出している
entries.en:
Countless
candlesticks lined
the room, lighting
it up brilliantly.

entries.jp:
本当ならば　大変に
煌びやかな部屋なのだろうが
どこか歪んで淀んで
薄暗く息苦しく感じる
entries.en:
It must have been
a truly dazzling
room, and yet it
felt warped and
stagnant
somehow, dim
and stifling.

entries.jp: ……まるで豪華な牢獄\nそんな感じじゃな
entries.en: ...Like some fancy\nprison, I reckon.

entries.jp:
下手に息をすれば
そのまま　呑み込まれ
染まってしまいそうな
そんな　怪しげな空気が
漂っていた
entries.en:
An eerie air
hung in the
room, as if one
careless breath
would swallow
you whole and
stain you with it.

entries.jp: ……しくしく
entries.en: ...*sob sob*

entries.jp: ん？　何か\n聞こえるような……
entries.en: Hm? I think I\nhear somethin'...

entries.jp: その声は　部屋の奥\n一段高いところから\n聞こえてくるようだった
entries.en:
The voice
seemed to come
from the back of
the room, from a
raised platform.

entries.jp: そこに誰か\nいるのか？
entries.en: Somebody there?

entries.jp: ……しくしく
entries.en: ...*sob sob*

entries.jp: 子供……？
entries.en: A child...?

entries.jp: だ　誰
entries.en: Wh-who's there?

entries.jp: あ……っと\nわしゃ　通りすがりの\nロックンローラーじゃが
entries.en: Ah... well, I'm just\na rock 'n' roller\npassin' through.

entries.jp: ……新しい\n小姓（こしょう）？
entries.en: ...A new page?

entries.jp: 違うぜよ\nよくわからないんじゃが\n置いてけぼりを食ってなぁ
entries.en: Nope. Couldn't\ntell ya how, but I\ngot left behind.

entries.jp: お前も\n一人ぼっち？
entries.en: Are you all\nalone too?

entries.jp: さっきまでは\n仲間と一緒だったんじゃが\nはぐれてしもうたぜよ
entries.en:
I was with my
pals till a minute
ago, but we got
separated.

entries.jp: そうか……\nでは予と同じだね
entries.en: I see... Then\nyou're the\nsame as me.

entries.jp: 予も\n一人になってしまった
entries.en: I've been left\nall alone too.

entries.jp: それで　お前さん\n泣いとったのか
entries.en: So that's why\nyou were cryin'.

entries.jp: なっ\n予は泣いてなどいない
entries.en: Wha-- I was\nnot crying!

entries.jp: だけど　ほれ\n目が赤いぞ
entries.en: But look, your\neyes are all red.

entries.jp: ち　違う……\nこれは……
entries.en: Th-that's\nnot... This is...

entries.jp: ああ　隠さなくてもいい\n子供は泣くものぜよ
entries.en:
Aw, no need
to hide it. Kids
cry, that's just
how it is.

entries.jp: 予は子供じゃない！\nもう　大人だ！
entries.en: I'm not a child!\nI'm a grown-up!

entries.jp: 大人はこんな所に\n閉じこめられて\n泣いたりしないぜよ
entries.en:
Grown-ups
don't sit locked
up in a place
like this cryin'.

entries.jp: 閉じこめられてなんて\nいないよ\n自分からここにいるんだ
entries.en: I'm not locked up.\nI'm here because\nI chose to be.

entries.jp: こんな薄暗いところにか？\n体に良くないぜよ？
entries.en:
In a gloomy
place like this?
That ain't
good for your
health, y'know.

entries.jp: そうしなければ\nならないんだ\nだから……
entries.en: I have to be.\nBecause...

entries.jp: 予の声は……\n歌は……皆を困らせる
entries.en: My voice... my\nsinging... causes\neveryone trouble.

entries.jp: ほう\n歌が好きなのか
entries.en: Oh? So you\nlike singin'?

entries.jp: うん　でも\nここでしか歌うことは\n許されてないけど
entries.en:
Yes. But I'm
not allowed to
sing anywhere
but here.

entries.jp: ははあ　もしや\nオンチというやつか
entries.en:
Ah-ha. Don't tell
me... you're one
of them
tone-deaf types?

entries.jp: えっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 隠すな隠すな\nわしも歌が下手ぜよ
entries.en: No need to hide\nit! I'm a lousy\nsinger myself.

entries.jp: 土佐じゃ　百年に一人の\nオンチじゃ言われたもんじゃ
entries.en:
Back in Tosa, they
said I was the
most tone-deaf
fella born in a
hundred years!

entries.jp: だから違うってば
entries.en: I told you,\nthat's not it.

entries.jp: その気持ちは　よくわかる\nああ　痛いほどわかる
entries.en:
I know just
how you feel.
Yep, I know it
so well it hurts.

entries.jp: もういいよ……
entries.en: Never mind...

entries.jp: 良かあない\nわしは坂本龍馬ぜよ
entries.en: Ain't no "never\nmind" about it! I'm\nRyoma Sakamoto!
Oh...

entries.jp: お前さんの名は？\n何て言うんじゃ？
entries.en: What's your\nname? What do\nthey call ya?

entries.jp: 予を知らないの？
entries.en: You don't know\nwho I am?

entries.jp: そりゃ\n初めて会ったんじゃ\n知ってるわけがない
entries.en: Well, we only\njust met. How\nwould I know?

entries.jp: 予は……そうだな\n皆からは上様と\n呼ばれている
entries.en: I'm... well...\nEveryone calls\nme "Ue-sama."

entries.jp: ウエ様かー\n様がつくってことは\n偉いトコのボンか？
entries.en:
Ue-sama, huh? If
there's a "-sama"
on it, you must be
some big family's
little master?

entries.jp: ボン？\nまあ　予は\nすごく偉いけど……
entries.en: Little master?\nWell... I am very\nimportant, but...

entries.jp: 誇るような\n口調とは裏腹に\n少年は顔を伏せる
entries.en: Despite his proud\nwords, the boy\nhung his head...

entries.jp: まるで　それが悲しい\nことでも有るかのように
entries.en: ...as though\nthat were\nsomething sad.

entries.jp: おかげで　自由に歌を\n歌うこともできなかった\n親しい友達もいない……
entries.en:
Because of it, I
could never sing
freely. I don't
have any close
friends, either...

entries.jp: お前さん　もしや……\nここにずっと一人で\nおるんか？
entries.en:
Hey... don't tell
me you've been
here all by
yourself this
whole time?

entries.jp: 時々　会いに\n来てくれる者も\nいるにはいるよ
entries.en: There is someone\nwho comes to see\nme sometimes.

entries.jp: だが　もう何日も\n会いに来てくれないんだ
entries.en: But he hasn't\ncome to see me\nfor days now.

entries.jp: 予は直弼に\n嫌われてしまった\nのかな……
entries.en: Has Naosuke\ncome to hate\nme, I wonder...

entries.jp: ……直弼？\n井伊直弼のことか？
entries.en: ...Naosuke? You\nmean Naosuke Ii?

entries.jp: 直弼がどこにいるか\n知ってるの？
entries.en: Do you\nknow where\nNaosuke is?

entries.jp: う……\n知ってるというか\n知らないというか
entries.en: Uh... Well, I\nkinda know and\nI kinda don't...

entries.jp: じゃあ\n直弼が来るまで\nお話しようよ
entries.en: Then let's talk\nuntil Naosuke\ncomes.

entries.jp: お話なあ……
entries.en: Talk, huh...

entries.jp: 歌は古来は戦いの\n道具だったんだって
entries.en:
They say that in
ancient times,
songs were
tools of war.

entries.jp: ……なんじゃ？
entries.en: ...Come again?

entries.jp: ねえ\nちゃんと聞いてる？
entries.en: Hey, are you\nlistening?

entries.jp: 良い歌は山を越えて\n敵も魅了したし
entries.en:
A good song
could cross
mountains and
charm even
the enemy...

entries.jp: 不思議な音楽は\n山をも崩したそうだよ
entries.en:
...and strange
music could
bring down
even mountains,
they say.

entries.jp: あ　ああ……\n昔はそうだったと\n聞くぜよ
entries.en:
O-oh, yeah...
I've heard it
was like that
back in the day.

entries.jp: ねえ……今でも\nその歌が残っていると\n聞いたらどうする？
entries.en:
Hey... what would
you do if I told
you that song still
survives today?

entries.jp:
少年が言葉を発する度
暗い部屋の中の明かりが
一つ……また一つ……と
消えてゆく
entries.en:
Each time the
boy spoke, the
lights in the dark
room went out...
one... by one...

entries.jp: ……なんか\nおかしくないか？
entries.en: ...Hey, ain't\nsomethin'\noff here?

entries.jp: ねえってば\n聞いてるの？
entries.en: Hey, come on. Are\nyou listening?

entries.jp: お　おう\n聞いとる\n聞いとるが――
entries.en: O-oh, sure. I'm\nlistenin', I'm\nlistenin', but--

entries.jp: ええと\n昔の歌の話だよな？
entries.en: Uh... this is\nabout the old\nsong, right?

entries.jp: 一度聞いてみたいぜよ\n面白そうじゃ
entries.en: I'd love to hear it\nonce! Sounds fun!

entries.jp: 面白い？\n面白くなんかないよ
entries.en: Fun? It's not\nfun at all.

entries.jp: 悲しい歌なんだ\n聴いた者の魂を虜にして\n人形のようにしてしまう
entries.en:
It's a sad song. It
captures the souls
of those who hear
it and turns them
into dolls.

entries.jp: そうなのか？\n歌は楽しいもんじゃろう
entries.en: Is that so?\nSongs oughta\nbe fun, though!

entries.jp: 悲しいように聞こえる歌も\n人の心を慰めて\nなごませてくれるぜよ
entries.en:
Even songs that
sound sad can
comfort folks'
hearts and soothe
'em, y'know.

entries.jp: 本当に？\n直弼を失った予の心も？
entries.en: Really? Even my\nheart, now that\nI've lost Naosuke?

entries.jp: 立ち上がった龍馬は\nふと　目の前にいる\n少年の違和感に気づく
entries.en:
Rising to his feet,
Ryoma suddenly
sensed something
wrong with the
boy before him.

entries.jp: そう言えば\nお前さんは……\n何故　無事なんじゃ？
entries.en: Come to think\nof it... why are\nyou all right?

entries.jp: 城中の皆が眠ってるのに\nなんで　お前さんだけ\n起きていられるんじゃ？
entries.en:
Everybody in
the castle's
asleep, so how
come you're the
only one awake?

entries.jp: お話の途中だよ
entries.en: I'm in the middle\nof my story.

entries.jp: その歌に名前はないんだ\nだって　歌に何の意味も\nないから……
entries.en:
That song has no
name. Because
the song has no
meaning at all...

entries.jp: もしや……
entries.en: Could it be...

entries.jp: 将軍\n徳川慶喜……様か
entries.en:
The shogun...
Yoshinobu
Tokugawa...
Yoshinobu-sama?

entries.jp: ……今でも徳川の血筋に\nその声を持つ者が現れて\nその方が将軍と呼ばれる
entries.en:
...Even now,
someone with
that voice is born
into the
Tokugawa
bloodline, and
that person is
called the shogun.

entries.jp:
なっ……
これは井伊の声
どこから聞こえて
くるんじゃ？
entries.en: Wha-- That's Ii's\nvoice! Where's it\ncomin' from!?

entries.jp: いや　これは井伊じゃない\n井伊の魂を食った\nあの『何か』の声ぜよ……
entries.en:
No, that ain't Ii.
That's the voice
of the 'something'
that devoured Ii's
soul...

entries.jp: 将軍は　皆から\n恐れられ　怖がられて\n城の奥に閉じこめられる
entries.en:
The shogun is
feared and
dreaded by all,
and shut away
deep within
the castle...

entries.jp: 歪められ強められた\n歴代の将軍たちの怨念と\n共に……
entries.en:
...together with
the grudges of
the shoguns
before him,
twisted and
made stronger.

entries.jp:
やがて……
全ての灯りが消え
月明かりに照らされた時
少年の影が一際強く
映し出される
entries.en:
At last... every
light went out,
and when the
moonlight shone
in, the boy's
shadow was cast
more starkly
than ever.

entries.jp: 薄い明かりにゆらゆらと\n照らされる影は\n明らかに人の物ではない
entries.en:
The shadow,
swaying in the
faint light, was
clearly not that
of a human.

entries.jp: お前さんが……\n第十五代将軍\n徳川慶喜様なのか……
entries.en:
So you're...
the fifteenth
shogun...
Yoshinobu-sama?

entries.jp: ……直弼\nどこにいるの？
entries.en: ...Naosuke,\nwhere are you?

entries.jp: いやだ　いやだ\n予を一人にしないで
entries.en: No, no! Don't\nleave me alone!

entries.jp: 怖いよ\n暗いよ\n淋しいよ
entries.en: I'm scared... It's\ndark... I'm lonely...

entries.jp: 予を助けて\n約束したじゃないか\nねえ直弼
entries.en: Save me! You\npromised, didn't\nyou, Naosuke?

entries.jp: 慶喜の悲痛な叫びに\n蠢く影は慰めるよう\n取り込むよう　動く
entries.en:
At Yoshinobu's
anguished cry,
the writhing
shadows moved
as if to comfort
him... as if to
swallow him.

entries.jp: 哀れなのは　慶喜よ\nずっと　辛く　苦しく\n淋しい思いをしてきた
entries.en:
Poor, poor
Yoshinobu. All
this time, you
have borne
such pain, such
suffering, such
loneliness.

entries.jp: さあ　慶喜\n今こそ歌おう\n原初の歌を
entries.en:
Now, Yoshinobu.
Now is the time to
sing. To sing the
primordial song.

entries.jp: そして民どもの魂を喰らい\n今一度……徳川の世を\n復活させるのだ
entries.en:
And devour the
souls of the
masses, and
revive the age
of the Tokugawa
once more...

entries.jp:
慶喜の背中から
何人もの声が
重なるように
天歌が響き渡る
entries.en:
From behind
Yoshinobu,
Heaven's Song
rang out, many
voices layered
over one another.

entries.jp: ……うっ\nなんじゃ　これは……！
entries.en: ...Ugh! What\nis this...!?

entries.jp: 地の底を這うような\n優しく甘く恐ろしい\n死神の歌が響く
entries.en:
A reaper's song
echoed, crawling
from the depths
of the earth,
gentle, sweet
and terrifying.

entries.jp: それは　魂そのものを\n掴み　引きずり出す歌
entries.en:
It was a song
that seized the
very soul and
dragged it out.

entries.jp: 慶喜は　自分を取り囲む\n影に向かって両手を広げ\n無邪気に微笑んだ
entries.en:
Yoshinobu
spread his arms
wide toward the
shadows around
him and smiled
innocently.

entries.jp: うん　直弼\n予は歌うよ
entries.en: Yes, Naosuke.\nI'll sing.

entries.jp: 影が慶喜の身体に\n注ぎ込まれ　瞳からは\n光が失われていく
entries.en:
The shadows
poured into
Yoshinobu's
body, and the
light faded
from his eyes.

entries.jp: その唇に浮かぶのは\n幾度も見てきた\nあの空虚な笑みだ
entries.en:
On his lips was
that hollow smile
he had seen so
many times.

entries.jp: いかん　将軍様\nその声は　井伊の\n声じゃない
entries.en: No, Lord\nShogun! That\nvoice ain't Ii's!

entries.jp: 聞いてはいかんぜよ……！
entries.en: Don't listen to it...!

entries.jp: どうして？\n直弼は　いつだって\n予の頼みを聞いてくれた
entries.en:
Why not?
Naosuke
always granted
my wishes.

entries.jp: 予も　直弼の頼みを\n聞いてあげるんだ
entries.en: So I'm going to\ngrant Naosuke's\nwish, too.

entries.jp: それとも　お前も\n他の者と同じように\n予を閉じ込めにきたの？
entries.en:
Or have you
come to lock me
away, just like
everyone else?

entries.jp: ち　違うぜよ\nわしは――
entries.en: N-no, that\nain't it! I--

entries.jp: だったら一緒に歌おうよ\nねえ　最高の天歌を\n聴かせてあげる――
entries.en:
Then let's sing
together. Listen,
I'll let you hear
the greatest
Heaven's Song--

entries.jp: 違う　違うぜよ！\nそれではダメなんじゃ！
entries.en: No! No, that ain't\nit! That's no good!

entries.jp: 将軍様が聞いておるのは\n過去の怨霊の声ぜよ……
entries.en:
What you're
listenin' to, Lord
Shogun, are the
voices of
vengeful ghosts
from the past...

entries.jp: 将軍様が歌おうと\nしておるのは\n過去の怨霊の歌ぜよ……
entries.en:
What you're
tryin' to sing,
Lord Shogun, is
a song of
vengeful ghosts
from the past...

entries.jp: それは明日へ繋がらない\n滅びの歌なんじゃ！
entries.en: That's a song of\nruin that don't\nlead to tomorrow!

entries.jp: 将軍様が歌うべきなのは\n未来と希望を紡ぐ歌\n新しい歌――
entries.en:
What you oughta
be singin', Lord
Shogun, is a song
that weaves the
future and hope...
a new song--

entries.jp: ロックンロールぜよ！
entries.en: Rock 'n' roll!

entries.jp: ロックンロール……？
entries.en: Rock 'n' roll...?

entries.jp: そうじゃ！\nロックじゃ！
entries.en: That's right! Rock!

entries.jp:
龍馬は
己を鼓舞するように
力の限り　ギターを
かき鳴らす
entries.en:
As if to rouse
himself, Ryoma
strummed his
guitar with all
his might.

entries.jp:
しかし
龍馬と慶喜を包む
闇はゆらりと
揺れるだけだ
entries.en:
But the darkness
enveloping
Ryoma and
Yoshinobu only
swayed gently.

entries.jp: だ　だめか……\nわしの歌だけじゃ\n将軍様を止められない
entries.en: N-no good... My\nsong alone can't\nstop the shogun...

entries.jp: ねえ？\nお前の魂を\nもらったら
entries.en: Hey... If I took\nyour soul...

entries.jp: そうしたら\n予はもう寂しく\nなくなるかな
entries.en: ...then maybe I\nwouldn't be\nlonely anymore.

entries.jp: お前の魂の輝きが\n失せるまでの間……\nほんの刹那でいいんだ
entries.en:
Just until the
glow of your soul
fades... Only for
an instant is fine.

entries.jp: お前の魂を\nみんなの魂を\n予におくれ……
entries.en: Your soul...\neveryone's souls...\ngive them to me...

entries.jp: ゆらめく闇をまとった\n慶喜の手が　ずぶりと\n龍馬の身体に沈んでいく
entries.en:
Yoshinobu's
hand, cloaked
in flickering
darkness,
sank deep into
Ryoma's body.

entries.jp: 遠のく意識の中\n龍馬の心に\n何かが浮かぶ
entries.en:
As his
consciousness
faded, something
rose up in
Ryoma's heart.

entries.jp: それは――
entries.en: It was--

entries.jp: 慶喜の悲しい顔
entries.en: Yoshinobu's\nsad face

entries.jp: 慶喜の悲しい顔
entries.en: Yoshinobu's\nsad face

entries.jp: 高杉と桂の顔
entries.en: Takasugi and\nKatsura's faces

entries.jp: 慶喜の悲しい顔
entries.en: Yoshinobu's\nsad face

entries.jp: 高杉と桂の顔
entries.en: Takasugi and\nKatsura's faces

entries.jp: 土方と沖田の顔
entries.en: Hijikata and\nOkita's faces

entries.jp: 慶喜の悲しい顔
entries.en: Yoshinobu's\nsad face

entries.jp: 高杉と桂の顔
entries.en: Takasugi and\nKatsura's faces

entries.jp: 土方と沖田の顔
entries.en: Hijikata and\nOkita's faces

entries.jp: ロックの魂
entries.en: The soul of rock

entries.jp: ……将軍様は\n歌いたいと言っていた
entries.en: ...The shogun\nsaid he wanted\nto sing.

entries.jp: たった一人\n闇の中で淋しいと\n言っていた
entries.en:
He said he
was lonely,
all by himself
in the dark.

entries.jp: そんな奴を\n放っておけるか
entries.en: How could I just\nleave a fella\nlike that be?

entries.jp: ずっと一人きりで\n歌ってきたわしに
entries.en: I'd always sung\nall on my own...

entries.jp: 誰かと一緒に歌う\n楽しさを教えてくれたんは\nあの二人じゃった……
entries.en:
The ones who
taught me how
fun it is to sing
with somebody
else... were
those two...

entries.jp: シンディ\nセンセー
entries.en: Shindy... Sensei...

entries.jp: 三人で　死ぬほど\n雷舞の稽古をしたよな
entries.en:
The three of us
rehearsed for
our live till we
nearly dropped
dead, didn't we?

entries.jp: たくさん歌って\nたくさんケンカして\nそればかりじゃったけど
entries.en:
We sang a
whole lot, and
fought a whole
lot. That's about
all we did, but...

entries.jp: こんなもんじゃ\n全然足りないぜよ！
entries.en: That ain't\nnear enough!

entries.jp: もっともっと\n一緒に歌いたい！
entries.en: I wanna sing\nwith you more\nand more!

entries.jp: ロックを\nこの日本中に\n響かせるまで――
entries.en: Till rock rings out\nall across Japan--

entries.jp: どうやら　わしは\nここまでみたいじゃ……
entries.en: Looks like... this\nis as far as I go...

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさん\nすまん
entries.en: Hijizo-san... sorry.

entries.jp: こんなわしを見て\nソウちんは　呆れる\nかもしれんな
entries.en:
If So-chin saw
me like this,
he'd probably be
fed up with me.

entries.jp: けど　わしはもう……
entries.en: But I just can't...

entries.jp: すべてを\nあきらめかけた\nその時だった
entries.en:
It happened
just as he was
about to give up
on everything.

entries.jp: これは……？
entries.en: What's this...?

entries.jp:
魂の奥底に　小さくとも
輝きを失わない力が
残されていることに
龍馬は気付いた
entries.en:
Ryoma realized
that deep in
his soul, there
remained a
power--small,
but never
losing its shine.

entries.jp: これは\n誠の志……
entries.en: This is... sincere\nresolve...

entries.jp: 何にも屈しない強い心と\n進むべき道が　そこに\nあった
entries.en:
A strong heart
that bows to
nothing, and
the path he
must walk--they
were there.

entries.jp: そうじゃ……\nこんなところで挫ける\nわけにはいかん！
entries.en:
That's right... I
can't go breakin'
down in a place
like this!

entries.jp: 誰もが自由に歌える\n争いのない世の中を
entries.en:
A world without
fightin', where
everybody can
sing freely...

entries.jp: この手で！\nロックで！\n掴み取るまでは――
entries.en: Till I grab hold\nof it with these\nhands! With rock!

entries.jp: わしが受け継いだ\nロックの魂は\nこんな事じゃ折れない！
entries.en:
The soul of rock
I inherited ain't
gonna break
over somethin'
like this!

entries.jp: 今　この瞬間だって\nわしの身体にはロックが\n溢れているぜよ……
entries.en:
Even right now,
this very
moment, my
body's overflowin'
with rock!

entries.jp: わしの命が欲しいなら\nくれてやる
entries.en: If you want my\nlife, take it.

entries.jp: けど　命を奪われようと\n歌う事だけは奪えんぜよ！
entries.en:
But even if you
take my life,
you can't take
away my singin'!

entries.jp: わしに　ロックの魂が\nある限り！
entries.en: Not as long\nas I've got the\nsoul of rock!

entries.jp: わしは……わしは……
負けるわけには\nいかないんじゃあーっ
entries.en: I ain't gonna\nlooooose!

entries.jp: うぁぁぁぁぁ……
entries.en: Uwaaaaah...

entries.jp: な……なん……じゃ？\n今　わしの体が光った\nような……
entries.en: Wh... what...?\nDid my body\njust... glow?

entries.jp: 見ると龍馬の片魂が\nほんのりと光を\n放っていた
entries.en:
Ryoma looked
down to see his
Piece Soul giving
off a faint light.

entries.jp: 感じる……\n感じるぜよ
entries.en: I feel it... I\ncan feel it!

entries.jp: そうか……\n闇に呑まれとったのは\nわしのほうじゃ無い
entries.en:
I see... I'm not
the one who got
swallowed by
the darkness.

entries.jp: 皆が将軍様の闇に\n呑まれとるんじゃ……
entries.en:
It's everybody
else who's been
swallowed by
the shogun's
darkness...

entries.jp: 助けてくれ……
entries.en: Help me...

entries.jp: ここは寒い……
entries.en: It's cold here...

entries.jp: 一人にしないでくれ……
entries.en: Don't leave\nme alone...

entries.jp: そこにおるんじゃな？\nみんな　今助けてやる！
entries.en:
You're in there,
ain't ya? Hang
on, everybody,
I'll save you!

entries.jp: だが……\nわしの力だけでは\n足りないぜよ
entries.en: But... my\nstrength alone\nain't enough.

entries.jp: 片魂に手を当て\n龍馬は必死に祈る
entries.en:
Hand on his
Piece Soul,
Ryoma prayed
with all his heart.

entries.jp: 未だ欠けたる片魂よ……\nお前の仲間を\nここへ招くぜよ
entries.en:
O Piece Soul, still
incomplete... I'm
callin' your fellow
Piece Souls here!

entries.jp: シンディ\n目を覚ませ
entries.en: Shindy, wake up!

entries.jp: ……ん？\nここは
entries.en: ...Hm? Where\nam I...

entries.jp: センセー！\nわしはここじゃ
entries.en: Sensei! I'm\nover here!

entries.jp: あれ　龍馬くん？
entries.en: Huh? Ryoma-kun?

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさん\nそれは幻じゃ
entries.en: Hijizo-san, that's\njust an illusion!

entries.jp: むっ\nなんだここは？
entries.en: Hm? What is\nthis place?

entries.jp: ソウちん\nわしの声を聴け
entries.en: So-chin, listen\nto my voice!

entries.jp: あれ？　僕は今\n階段を上ってた\nはずじゃ……
entries.en:
Huh? I was
climbing the
stairs just now,
wasn't I...?

entries.jp: あっ！\n龍馬
entries.en: Ah! Ryoma!

entries.jp: このバカ\nどこに行ってたんだ
entries.en: You idiot!\nWhere the hell\nhave you been?

entries.jp: 城中を走り回って\n捜したんだぞ！
entries.en: We ran all over\nthe castle\nlooking for you!

entries.jp: 本当に　心配\nかけてくれるよ
entries.en: You really know\nhow to make\npeople worry.

entries.jp: みんな　幻の中に\n閉じ込められていたんじゃ
entries.en: Everybody was\ntrapped inside\nan illusion.

entries.jp: 幻の京の中の\n幻の城の中に\n取り込まれていたんじゃ
entries.en:
We got pulled
into an illusion of
a castle, inside an
illusion of Kyoto.

entries.jp: 幻……？\nどういうことですか？
entries.en: An illusion...?\nWhat do you\nmean?

entries.jp: わしらは気付かない内に\n魂を抜き取られていたぜよ
entries.en:
Without even
noticin', we had
our souls pulled
right out of us.

entries.jp: 本当のわしらは　恐らく\nお登勢やん達と同じように\nどこかで眠っているはず
entries.en:
Our real bodies
are prob'ly
sleepin'
somewhere, same
as Otose-yan and
the others.

entries.jp: 魂を抜き取られた？
entries.en: Our souls were\npulled out?

entries.jp: それじゃあ\nオレ様達はもう\n助からねえのか？
entries.en:
Then yours
truly and the
rest of us...
we're done for?

entries.jp: いや　わしらはまだ\n幻の中で自由に動ける
entries.en:
Nope. We can
still move
freely inside
the illusion.

entries.jp: まだ　魂を食われては\nいないということぜよ
entries.en: That means our\nsouls ain't been\ndevoured yet!

entries.jp: そこにいるのが――\nそれが慶喜様なのか？
entries.en: The one\nthere... is that\nYoshinobu-sama?

entries.jp: 違う\n将軍様に取り憑いた\n徳川家の怨念ぜよ
entries.en:
Nope. That's the
grudge of the
Tokugawa clan
that's possessin'
the shogun!

entries.jp: 覚えがある\n僕の中にいたのも\nこいつだ
entries.en: I remember it.\nThat's what was\ninside me, too.

entries.jp: 誰の為の泰平でもない\nただひたすらに人の魂を\n喰らう化け物――
entries.en:
A monster that
ain't bringin'
peace for
anybody, just
devourin'
people's souls,
over and over--

entries.jp: 将軍様も　魂を囚われ\n幻を見せられているんじゃ
entries.en:
The shogun's
soul's been
captured too.
It's makin' him
see illusions!

entries.jp: 龍馬の言葉に\nわかったと言うように\nそれぞれが声をあげる
entries.en:
At Ryoma's
words, each of
them called out,
as if to say they
understood.

entries.jp: 目を覚ませ\n慶喜様
entries.en: Wake up,\nYoshinobu-sama!

entries.jp: あなたはひとりぼっち\nなんかじゃありません！
entries.en: You are not\nall alone!

entries.jp: 貴方が本当に必要と\nしているのは　そんな\n怨念などではないはず
entries.en:
What you truly
need is surely
not some
grudge like that.

entries.jp: 必要なのは　心を開いて\n自分から手を伸ばすこと\nできるはずだよ
entries.en:
What you need
is to open your
heart and reach
out yourself.
You can do it.

entries.jp: さあ\n一緒に歌うぜよ\n明日へ繋がる歌を――
entries.en:
Come on, let's
sing together! A
song that leads
to tomorrow--

entries.jp: オレ様達が作る未来は\n哀しみも　寂しさも\n何もかも　ぶっ飛ばすぜ！
entries.en:
The future
we make is
gonna blow
away sadness,
loneliness,
everything!

entries.jp: 何が起こるかなんて\n誰にもわからない\n私にもわからない――
entries.en: No one knows\nwhat will happen.\nNot even I know--

entries.jp: だけど　歌うんだ\nだから　歌うんだ！
entries.en: But we sing.\nThat's why\nwe sing!

entries.jp: 思い描いた明日を\n歌いたいままに！
entries.en:
The tomorrow
we've dreamed
of, sung just
how we want!

entries.jp: みんなの想いを\n一つの音楽にしよう――
entries.en: Let's make all\nour feelings\ninto one music--

entries.jp: \fnt1ウルトラソウル！\nロックンロール\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Ultra Soul!\nRock 'n' roll!\fnt0
